intervention: Exactly five+1gripper commands: fixedsteps25..29; first aligned/narrow-gripper observation; same target plus seven zero joint-delta commands. Target conditions fall back tosteps45..49 so allassigned episodes receive5commands. No resampling or episode exclusion.

primary: Stochastic final physical success, paired over all512assigned episodes per fixed source. Targeted-minus-unchanged and targeted-zero-arm-minus-unchanged require mean gain>=.20 and positive98.75%interval lower bound.
secondary: Targeted-minus-scheduled timing gain requires>=.10 and positive98.75%lower bound. Zero-arm-minus-targeted isolates added arm action control. Deterministic scores and stage completion are diagnostic.

validity: Same initial reset and pre-intervention observations must match unchanged baseline within1e-5; common Gaussian draws consumed even when overridden; exact5command budget; all work counted. Stop on execution or pairing failure.
falsification: If neither target intervention meets the primary material screen, the specified opening repair is insufficient. Do not infer absence of every possible release bottleneck. Hand-specified success cannot establish sample-efficient learning.
followup: Reassess before any training. Any learned correction needs separate training data and explicit assistance accounting; public diagnostic trajectories never become learner input.
scope: Manual causal intervention only; preserve all frozen benchmark artifacts and policy scores.
